 Dr.Althea Announces Early Black Friday 2026 Sale: Up to 50% Off Best-Selling K-Beauty Skincare Ahead of Thanksgiving
 Oleh PR NEWSWIRE 
 17 November 2026, 2:00 pm 
 Share on facebook

 Share on linkedin 
 Dr.Althea’s Early Black Friday sale on Amazon features one of its biggest sales of the year, with up to 50% off cult-favorite K-beauty products ahead of the holiday rush. 
 NEW YORK , Nov. 17, 2026 /PRNewswire/ — Dr.Althea, the Korean dermatological skincare brand known for its best-selling 345 Relief Cream, announced its Amazon Early Black Friday 2026 sale today. From November 19 to November 26, 2026, shoppers will be able to save up to 50% on cult-favorite skincare products through Amazon. This provides an early opportunity to secure Thanksgiving and holiday gifts before the seasonal rush.
 Dr.Althea 345 Relief Line 
 The sale highlights skincare essentials specifically formulated for colder, drier months. Customers can find significant savings on barrier-supporting moisturizers, deep, hydrating serums, and makeup-friendly facial mists designed to keep skin comfortable and hydrated through dry indoor heat.
 Dr.Althea Amazon Early Black Friday 2026 Offer Details 
 Dr.Althea’s Early Black Friday sale features base discounts combined with stackable multi-buy savings, bringing the total discount to up to 50% off.
 Base Discounts: Up to 45% off select products, including best-sellers, new launches, and curated sets.
 Stackable Multi-Buy Savings: Shoppers get an extra 5% off when they buy 2 products, or an extra 10% off when they buy 3 or more. This multi-buy discount stacks on top of sale prices*, ensuring maximum value for winter skincare upgrades.
 *Multi-buy discounts exclude 0.5 fl oz products. 
 Featured Fall and Winter Skincare Picks 
 345 Relief Cream 
 Dr.Althea’s best-selling 345 Relief Cream has sold more than 40 million units worldwide as of November 2026. Formulated with the brand’s proprietary 345 Relief Complex™, it helps soothe skin and improve the look of post-blemish marks.
 Features a lightweight texture that works as a skin prep before makeup; a go-to for celebrity makeup artists.
 Non-comedogenic and suitable for acne-prone and sensitive skin.
 147 Barrier Cream 
 The 147 Barrier Cream strengthens the skin barrier and improves elasticity, an ideal fit for dry, tight winter skin.
 Ectoin, Ceramide NP, Betaine, Betulin, and NAD work together to nourish and strengthen skin.
 7 hyaluronic acids hydrate at multiple depths for long-lasting moisture.
 Clinically tested to improve the skin barrier by 71.98% after a single use on externally stressed skin. ** 
 345 Relief Cream Mist 
 The 345 Relief Cream Mist combines a cream and toner layer in one bottle for rich nourishment and refreshing, long-lasting hydration.
 60% Rice Bran Water nourishes skin, while 10,000 ppm Panthenol and Madecassoside soothe irritation.
 Ultra-fine mist can be used before, during, and after makeup without disturbing the base.
 Available in 3.38 Fl Oz and a travel-friendly 2.02 Fl Oz.
 345 Relief Serum 
 Sharing the 345 Relief Complex™ with the 345 Relief Cream, this serum delivers deep hydration for fall and winter.
 Contains 32% Tea Tree Leaf Water to soothe skin.
 Clinically proven to increase skin hydration by 125.42% after a single use.***
 Reju PDRN Cream Line (2000, 5000, 10000) 
 Available in three PDRN concentrations tailored to specific skin needs. All three feature a lightweight yet hydrating texture and are dermatologically tested by German Dermatest.
 Reju PDRN 2000 Cream : Contains 2,000 ppm PDRN for daily skin recovery and barrier support.
 Reju PDRN 5000 Cream : Contains 5,000 ppm PDRN to soothe, hydrate, firm, and support the skin barrier.
 Reju PDRN 10000 Cream : Contains 10,000 ppm PDRN for intensive hydration, soothing, firmness, and barrier care.
 **147 Barrier Cream: clinical study on skin barrier, soothing and elasticity conducted by the Korea Institute of Dermatological Sciences with 21 male and female participants aged 25–67, from November 13 to November 27 2025.
 ***345 Relief Serum: clinical study on skin hydration conducted by the Korea Institute of Dermatological Sciences with 21 male and female participants aged 30–65 on March 16, 2026.
 Frequently Asked Questions 
 When is the 2026 Dr.Althea Early Black Friday sale? Dr.Althea’s Early Black Friday sale runs from November 19 to November 26, 2026, on Amazon.
 How much can I save during the Dr.Althea Early Black Friday sale? With base discounts on best-sellers, new launches, and bundles, combined with the extra multi-buy discount stacked on top, shoppers can save up to 50%.
 Can the multi-buy discount be combined with sale prices? Yes. The extra 5% (2 products) or 10% (3 or more products) applies on top of sale prices. Please note that 0.5 Fl Oz sizes are excluded from this offer.
 Is the 345 Relief Cream good for acne-prone skin? Yes. The 345 Relief Cream is non-comedogenic and suitable for acne-prone and sensitive skin. It helps soothe skin and improve the look of post-blemish marks.
 Can the 345 Relief Cream Mist be used over makeup? Yes. Its ultra-fine mist can be used before, during, and after makeup to add hydration without disturbing the base.
 To explore the full range of early holiday deals, visit the Dr.Althea Amazon store starting November 19.
 About Dr.Althea 
 Founded in 2014, Dr.Althea is a Korean dermatology-inspired skincare brand focused on long-term skin recovery and compromised skin barriers. Blending advanced dermatological science with high-performance ingredients, all products are formulated for sensitive skin. Dr.Althea is best known for its 345 Relief Cream, a fungal acne-safe moisturizer, which has surpassed 40 million units sold worldwide as of November 2026. Building on its success, Dr.Althea continues to expand its science-backed product portfolio to address a wider range of skin concerns and strengthen its presence in the global beauty market. Dr.Althea is available through doctoraltheaglobal.com ,  Amazon , Ulta Beauty , and Olive Young Global .
